champion.tips: MORDEKAISER TIPS AND TRICKS When ganking, try and get as close as you can to the enemy before using your E so it’s easier for you to land this ability. Focus the biggest threat on the enemy team with your Ultimate R in team fights. This will make it easier for your team to handle the rest of them. You need time to come online, so focus on farming and getting as much gold and XP as possible in the early game.
champion.builds: THE BEST MORDEKAISER BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Mordekaiser Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Riftmaker. For your last 3 items, you should build Liandry's Torment, Spirit Visage and finish with Jak'Sho, The Protean. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 56.6% winrate over 470 matches played. Optional Your second option for Mordekaiser Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Gathering Storm with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Liandry's Torment, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Riftmaker, Spirit Visage and Jak'Sho, The Protean. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 47.8% win rate over 224 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Liandry's Torment as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Riftmaker as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spirit Visage, Thornmail and Jak'Sho, The Protean. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 46.4% win rate across 220 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Mordekaiser Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Gathering Storm with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Riftmaker as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Experimental Hexplate as third item. The last 3 options are Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Liandry's Torment and Spirit Visage. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 54.5% win rate over 202 matches played. Situational Mordekaiser Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Mordekaiser build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Mordekaiser runes page.
